question: In a certain code language, ‘SOMEONE’ is written as ‘1645655’ and ‘BRINJAL’ is written as ‘2995113’. How will ‘NOVEMBER’ be written in that language?
solution:
Explanation:

According to the English alphabets and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 
The pattern followed in the given codes is:

 **The sum of digits in the positional value is the code.

 In case of 10, 1 is taken.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b447ea6db663475a90ef1a463000b8cec1522f61b152d9c5b70f6bef51c9ea66.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/349a7f8dd51951519f0aaf159a5e9c2c916acd84c83e09b30cc11ffeb107b627.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 1.**
